data.description:
## Context

Run the rebar-janitor codebase-health pipeline against the current rebar repository as a deliberate maintenance pause. This is a read-only audit of product code: the deliverables are durable audit artifacts, a human-approved remediation plan, and tracker tickets. No production or test code will be changed.

## Scope

Inspect the repository for code debt, code and architectural smells, separation-of-concerns problems, spent optionality, documentation gaps, oversized units, weak test oracles, AI-generated-code and security smells, and temporal decay. Weight recently changed regions while covering the full codebase. Consult prior janitor artifacts, tickets, ADRs, and commit history so intentional decisions are not mistaken for defects.

## Plan

1. Discovery: fan out one concern per independent agent, shard comment and test-suite review by subsystem, and pool path:line-cited findings without severity or confidence.
2. Verification: independently blue-team each finding, establish reachable harm, check prior decisions and known-fine entries, apply the fixed validity/impact floors, and persist the audit record plus reusable tool playbook.
3. Remediation: obtain two blind proposals per survivor from asymmetric evidence bases (community practice versus project record), converge at move/end-state level, and research divergences.
4. Approval: present the Remediation Plan one item at a time for human approve/refine/reject decisions; record explicit known-fine blessings only when given.
5. Ticketization: create a Janitor Cleanup epic and actionable child tickets for approved items, with acceptance criteria, provenance, dependencies, and file impact.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Discovery covers every required concern and every candidate has exact repository evidence with no discovery-time severity or confidence.
- [ ] Independent verification records validity, impact, reachable harm, and prior-decision handling; candidates below validity 0.75 or impact 0.5 are dropped.
- [ ] The dated audit record and reusable tool playbook are persisted under .rebar-janitor; the report identifies commands, thresholds, survivors, drops, and plan outcomes.
- [ ] Every surviving finding receives two blind asymmetric-evidence remediation proposals and any divergence is researched before the plan is presented.
- [ ] Each remediation item is individually approved, refined, or rejected by the user before ticket creation.
- [ ] Approved work is filed as child tickets under a Janitor Cleanup epic and linked back to this audit.
- [ ] No production code, tests, configuration, or documentation outside the janitor audit artifacts and tracker is modified.
data.title: Run codebase-health janitor audit — 2026-08-29
